about.title: About the game
about.intro: Pentilius is a strategy game for busy people. A meteorite changes Earth forever. Over generations, the survivors become five distinct races and realise they need one another. Together they leave Earth and colonise Pentilius — a planet with a hostile atmosphere, home to dangerous creatures called the Pentili. Somewhere deep inside the planet lies the Core — the Pentili's nest.

sections.heading: What you do in the game
bullets: Develop your base. Build Metal and Crystal mines, a warehouse, a research center, a reactor and defenses. Construction keeps going while you're away.

Build a combat robot. There are no classes — your robot is whatever you equip: head, arms, armor, core and legs. Upgrade the parts, hunt for rare items with bonus effects and spend points on your attributes.
Hunt the Pentili. Battles are automatic — you choose the opponent and your robot fights on its own. Earn experience, resources and items, and unlock new, more dangerous lands.
Send expeditions. Missions of 1, 5 or 10 hours that bring rewards while you're busy with something else.
Attack other players. Steal part of their resources — but be careful, their defenses grow too.
Play in a clan. The five races aren't enemies — a clan with more different races gets a bonus. Together you build clan buildings, form squads against bosses and fight clan wars.

Attack the Core. Every season ends with the clans attacking the Pentili's nest. The clan that deals the most damage wins the season. Then everything starts over — and everyone starts on equal footing again.

sections.heading: You don't play alone
bullets: The clan chat is where attacks are planned, places in boss squads are shared out and resources are gathered for the clan's buildings.
Friends and private messages — add people you know or meet in the game and chat with them.
Market — sell equipment you don't need to other players and buy the parts you're missing, at a price that works for you.

sections.heading: Why it's different
bullets: It's made for people with little time. A few minutes a day are enough: collect, build, send your robot into battle and get on with your day.
You don't need to be online all the time. Timers keep running while you're away, and energy refills on its own.
No manual control and no reflexes. What matters is your decisions: equipment, development, choice of target and teamwork with your clan.
There's always something to do: daily missions, rewards for a streak of active days and achievements through the season.
It plays in your browser, with nothing to install.

sections.heading: Who is behind the game
paragraphs: Pentilius is developed and run by {company}, {address}. Questions: {email}.
Choose your race and join the battle for Pentilius!

lore.title: The story
lore.intro: This is the story of a humanity that had to become something more in order to survive.

sections.heading: The meteorite
paragraphs: The sky above Earth split open for a single day. The meteorite did not destroy humanity — it changed it. What it brought seeped into the soil, the water and the blood of the survivors.
Over generations, people divided into five distinct bloodlines — each marked by the change in its own way.

sections.heading: The five races
bullets: Luxari — Masters of Technology. Brilliant engineers and innovators who push the boundaries of science.
Vorlun — Harmonizers of Life. In tune with nature, they excel in biology, medicine and sustainable development.
Zaryth — Keepers of Knowledge. Scholars and seekers of truth who archive and interpret the wisdom of the past.
Thalion — Guardians of Honor. Proud and disciplined, unmatched in leadership, strategy and combat.
Nexar — Forgers of Strength. Resilient and relentless, they thrive in the harshest places and turn resources into power.

sections.heading: One purpose
paragraphs: For a long time the five races walked separate paths. But Earth was running out, and none of them could build a future alone. So, for the first time, they united — not because they were alike, but because they needed one another.
Together, humanity left Earth and reached the planet Pentilius.

sections.heading: Pentilius
paragraphs: Pentilius was not made for humans. Its air is unbreathable for all five races — outside the protected bases the colonists wear helmets and oxygen systems, and the bases process the local atmosphere to make air. Earth's crops grow only in sealed, controlled environments.
And the planet is not empty. It belongs to the Pentili — dangerous native creatures that guard their lands.

sections.heading: The Core
paragraphs: Deep beneath the surface, humans found something ancient — a system that keeps the atmosphere and life of Pentilius the way they are. It was not built for humans, and it is no convenient terraforming machine.
But through the Core, that system can be influenced. Whoever takes control of it will lay the foundations of a new civilization.
Every clan knows that only one of them will be first.

rules.title: Rules and Terms of Use
rules.intro: These terms govern your use of Pentilius. By creating an account you accept them together with the Privacy Policy. The game is provided by {company}, company ID {eik}, {address} ("we").

sections.heading: 1. Who can play
paragraphs: You must be at least {minAge} years old. If you are below the age at which you can consent to the processing of personal data on your own in your country (14 in Bulgaria), you need permission from a parent or guardian.

sections.heading: 2. Your account
bullets: You are responsible for keeping your account and password secure. Do not share them.
Your username must be appropriate and must not impersonate another person, a moderator or the game team.
You can delete your account at any time from Settings. Deletion happens {graceDays} days after you confirm, and you can cancel until then.

sections.heading: 3. Code of conduct
paragraphs: We have zero tolerance for offensive and harmful content. The following are not allowed:
bullets: insults, harassment, threats, stalking, and inciting hatred or violence;
sexual, racist, discriminatory or otherwise offensive content — in names, descriptions, clans and messages;
spam, advertising and scams, including attempts to obtain someone else's account or data;
cheats, bots, automation and knowingly exploiting bugs (please report bugs to {email});
abusing the report feature, including mass or deliberately false reports;
sharing other people's personal data.

sections.heading: 4. Reporting, blocking and moderation
bullets: Any player can block another player and report a profile, a clan or a message.
Reports are reviewed by moderators. A report on its own never punishes anyone.
For violations we may remove content, change a name, or suspend or permanently ban an account, depending on how serious the violation is.

sections.heading: 5. Seasons and virtual items
bullets: The game is seasonal. At the end of a season in-game progress resets; your account stays.
Resources, items and everything else in the game have no real-money value and cannot be cashed out.

sections.heading: 6. Availability
paragraphs: The game is provided "as is". We do our best to keep it available and bug-free, but there may be downtime, maintenance and changes to balance and content.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We may change these terms. We will announce significant changes in the game. Continuing to play after a change means you accept it.

sections.heading: 8. Governing law and contact
paragraphs: Bulgarian law applies. For questions and complaints, write to {email}.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data we process in Pentilius, why, and what your rights are.

sections.heading: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: {company}, company ID {eik}, {address}. Contact for personal-data questions: {email}.

sections.heading: 2. What we collect
bullets: Account data: email, username, password (stored only in hashed form), chosen race, language, and when you accepted the terms.
Game data: level, resources, items, buildings, battles, clan, donations, war and season participation.
Content you create: your profile description, clan names and descriptions, clan-chat and private messages.
Safety data: reports you file or that are filed against you, blocks, sanctions.
Technical data: when you were last active. Our servers may technically log IP addresses for security purposes.

sections.heading: 3. Why we process it
bullets: to provide the game and your account (performance of a contract);
for security, fraud prevention and content moderation (legitimate interest);
to meet legal obligations where they apply.

sections.heading: 4. Who we share it with
paragraphs: We do not sell personal data or use it for advertising. Data is stored with hosting and backup providers that process it only on our behalf. Other players see only your public information: username, race, level, clan, profile description, and the messages you send them.

sections.heading: 5. How long we keep it
bullets: For as long as your account exists.

When you delete your account, your personal data is removed {graceDays} days after you confirm. Game history (battles, wars, market, donations) stays, but no longer linked to you — shown as "Deleted player".
Database backups are kept for a limited time and then replaced.
Reports about violations may be kept longer to protect other players.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access, rectify and erase your data, to restrict processing, to data portability and to object. You can delete your account yourself from Settings; for anything else write to {email}. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection authority — in Bulgaria, the Commission for Personal Data Protection (www.cpdp.bg).

sections.heading: 7. Children
paragraphs: The game is not intended for anyone under {minAge}. If you are below the age at which you can consent to the processing of personal data on your own in your country (14 in Bulgaria), you need permission from a parent or guardian. If we learn that an account belongs to a child under {minAge}, we will delete it.

sections.heading: 8. Cookies and local storage
paragraphs: We use no advertising or tracking cookies. Your browser only stores what the game needs to work — your login session and chosen language.

sections.heading: 9. Changes
paragraphs: We may update this policy. The date of the last change is shown at the top.

support.title: Support
support.intro: Got a question, a problem, or found a bug? Write to us at {email} — we reply as soon as we can. If you have an account, you can also write to us from inside the game: Settings → Contact the team.

sections.heading: I forgot my password
paragraphs: Write to {email} from the email address you registered with, and include your username.

sections.heading: Someone is insulting me or posting offensive things
paragraphs: Open their profile or tap "⋯" next to the message — from there you can block and report them. Reports are reviewed by moderators.

sections.heading: I found a bug
paragraphs: Describe what happened and where to {email}. Please don't use the bug to your advantage — that breaks the Rules.

sections.heading: My account is suspended
paragraphs: When you log in you will see the reason and how long the suspension lasts. If you think it is a mistake, write to {email}.

sections.heading: How do I delete my account
paragraphs: Log in → Settings → "Delete account". Details are on the "Delete account" page.

deleteAccount.title: Delete account
deleteAccount.intro: You can delete your Pentilius account at any time.

sections.heading: How
bullets: Log in to the game.
Open Settings and scroll to "Delete account".
Tap "Delete my account", then enter the code shown and your password.

sections.heading: What happens next
paragraphs: The deletion happens {graceDays} days after you confirm. Until then you can keep playing and cancel with one button.

sections.heading: What is deleted
paragraphs: Your email, password, profile description, items, buildings, resources, friends and private messages.

sections.heading: What stays
paragraphs: Game history — battles, wars, market, clan donations, Core points and clan-chat messages — stays, but is no longer linked to you and shows as "Deleted player". Database backups are kept for a limited time and then replaced.

sections.heading: I can't access my account
paragraphs: If you can't log in (for example because your account is suspended), write to {email} from the email address you registered with, with the subject "Account deletion", and include your username.
